snippet.title: EA SPORTS FC™ 27 | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Everyone’s playing The World’s Game. Get EA SPORTS FC™ 27 Ultimate Edition to Play Now with Early Access: https://x.ea.com/92504

Step into The Grounds to experience a football playground where the streets meet the stadium, and feel greater control in every mode as community-driven innovations deliver more true-to-football gameplay: https://x.ea.com/92507

Everyone’s playing, wherever they are. Join EA SPORTS FC™ Mobile with the new 27 Season Update, launching 24th September. Play Now: fcmobile.sng.link/Dn1ol/pd11

Subscribe to see more from EA SPORTS FC™: http://bit.ly/pzw4VD
